items.evidence: Adjusted diluted EPS was established as the performance criterion for all NEOs.
The Compensation Committee approved a performance goal based on ROTCE divided by COE with potential payouts ranging from 100% to 200%
The Compensation Committee selected the performance measure of ROTCE because it reflects the capital position of the company absent the effects of goodwill
COE is calculated using the Capital Asset Pricing Model, which is a commonly used financial metric
